questions: Do the CLI handlers correctly construct URLs and body payloads matching the server's Zod validation schemas?
Is the --env parameter correctly implemented as a plain body field with manifest-based defaults?
Are the new commands correctly wired into the CLI's switch-based routing?
Does the hxFetch URL construction produce the correct server endpoint paths?

answers.answer: Yes. cmdNetsuite POSTs to /{repoId}/netsuite using hxFetch with basePath defaulting to /api/inspect. For queries: { type: 'query', query, env? }. For logs: { type: 'logs', scriptId?, env? }. Both match server's inspectNetsuiteBody discriminated union. cmdRun POSTs to /{repoId}/run with { code, modules?, env? }, matching server's runSuitescriptBody schema. modules are split from comma-separated string to array, matching z.array(z.string()).

Yes. Both handlers read nsDefaultEnv from /tmp/helix-inspect/manifest.json via readManifestDefaultEnv(). Maps PRODUCTION -> 'prod', SANDBOX -> 'sandbox', returns undefined if manifest unavailable. --env flag takes precedence (envFlag ?? readManifestDefaultEnv()). env included in body only when defined. Server's Zod validates z.enum(['prod','sandbox']).optional() and resolveEnvironment defaults undefined to SANDBOX.

Yes. inspect/index.ts imports cmdNetsuite at line 8 and dispatches via 'case netsuite' at line 125 with --repo validation and help text including usage examples. index.ts imports cmdRun at line 17 and dispatches via 'case run' at line 101 with configOrHelp guard, matching the pattern of other top-level commands (comments, preview).

Yes. hxFetch(config, path, options) constructs URL as config.url + basePath + path. basePath defaults to '/api/inspect'. So '/{repoId}/netsuite' becomes '/api/inspect/{repoId}/netsuite' and '/{repoId}/run' becomes '/api/inspect/{repoId}/run'. Server routes are apiRouter.post('/inspect/:repositoryId/netsuite') and apiRouter.post('/inspect/:repositoryId/run'), which resolve to /api/inspect/:repositoryId/netsuite and /api/inspect/:repositoryId/run. URLs match.

statement: Fresh independent code review of BLD-693 CLI implementation (helix-cli) confirms correct implementation of both new subcommands. All 4 changed files reviewed. cmdNetsuite (query/logs modes) and cmdRun (SuiteScript execution) correctly construct URLs, body payloads, and environment defaults matching the server's Zod validation schemas. --env is a plain body parameter with manifest-based defaults per Override 1. hxFetch URL construction verified to produce correct server endpoint paths. Both commands correctly wired into CLI routing. No code changes needed. Quality gates blocked by network unavailability.
